paths.name: @postsig/toolkit
paths.message: Importing the toolkit barrel pulls server-only code into client chunks. Import the subpath instead, e.g. '@postsig/toolkit/abilities' or '@postsig/toolkit/constants'.

paths.name: @/constants/prompts
paths.message: Prompt constants are server-only. Reach them through a server component or server action instead of importing '@/constants/prompts' from client code.

patterns.message: Prompt constants are server-only. Reach them through a server component or server action instead of importing '@/constants/prompts/*' from client code.
